patch_description: Optimal Heilbronn configurations for n=13 are believed to lie on the boundary of a convex polygon. I replace the random interior points with points on a circle (scale-invariant since the metric normalizes by hull area), and perform a deterministic seeded local optimization of the 13 angular positions to maximize the minimum triangle area over all C(13,3)=286 triangles. Triangle areas on a unit circle have a cheap closed form: 0.5*|sin(Δ1)+sin(Δ2)+sin(Δ3)|. Starting from a regular 13-gon, we apply adaptive random perturbations (accepting improvements) with fixed seed, which converges quickly and reproducibly to a strong configuration.
